evals.prompt: I keep having this idea about a parking app. You know how in most cities you circle the block forever looking for a spot? I want to build something that shows where parking is actually available in real time. My buddy says everyone has tried this and it never works, but I think with the right data source it could. Can you help me turn this into a real plan I can act on?
evals.expected_output: A one-page markdown plan for the parking idea following the skill template: one-liner, problem, audience, solution, differentiators, MVP scope, risks, next actions. The interviewer asks probing questions (one at a time) to sharpen the vague spots like who the user is and how the data would actually be sourced.
expectations: Plan includes the MVP scope section
Plan includes the Next actions section
Audience section names a specific user, not a generic everyone
